items.body_raw: וַיִּנָּחֶם יהוה כִּי עָשָׂה אֶת־הָאָדָם בָּאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh repented that he had made man on the earth.

items.body_raw: בָּא הָאֹיֵב אֶל־הָעִיר וְלֹא יָכֹל לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ
items.answer_raw: The enemy came to the city, but he was not able to fight against it.

items.body_raw: And the earth was corrupted, and all flesh was cut off by the waters of the flood.
items.answer_raw: וַתִּשָּׁחֵת הָאָרֶץ וַיִּכָּרֵת כָּל־בָּשָׂר מִמֵּי הַמַּבּוּל

items.body_raw: Let me escape in the day of fighting (inf. cons.).
items.answer_raw: אִמָּלְטָה בְּיוֹם הִלָּחֵם

items.body_raw: Trust in Yahweh with all thy heart, and lean not unto (אֶל־) thine own understanding.
items.answer_raw: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה בְּכָל־לִבְּךָ וְאַל־תִּשָּׁעֵן אֶל־בִּינָתְךָ

items.body_raw: We went down unto the city to fight against it, but we could not destroy it.
items.answer_raw: יָרַדְנוּ אֶל־הָעִיר לְהִלָּחֵם עָלֶיהָ וְלֹא יָכֹלְנוּ לְהַשְׁמִיד אֹתָהּ

items.body_raw: טַהֲרֵנִי
items.answer_raw: Cleanse thou me (Pi. imperat. with 1 s. suffix: pf. טִהַר, impf. יְטַהֵר)

items.body_raw: טַעֲמוּ
items.answer_raw: Taste ye (Qal)

items.body_raw: בָּרְכוּ
items.answer_raw: Bless ye (Pi.)

items.body_raw: יְשָׁרֵת
items.answer_raw: He will serve (Pi.)

items.body_raw: זַעֲקִי
items.answer_raw: Cry thou (f. Qal)

items.body_raw: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ
items.answer_raw: And they fought (Niph.)

items.body_raw: וִיטַהֵר
items.answer_raw: He will cleanse (Pi.)

items.body_raw: אֶרְחַץ
items.answer_raw: I will wash (Qal)

items.body_raw: רֻחַצְתְּ
items.answer_raw: Thou (f.) hast been washed (Pu.)

items.body_raw: אֶרְחָצֵךְ
items.answer_raw: I will wash (Qal) thee (f.: see § 31. 3 (a) i)

items.body_raw: נִבְחֲרָה
items.answer_raw: Let us choose (1 pl. cohortat. Qal)

items.body_raw: מְצַעֵק
items.answer_raw: Crying aloud (Pi. ptc. m.)

items.body_raw: וַיְגָרֶשׁ יהוה אֶת־הָאָדָם וַיְשַׁלְּחֵהוּ מִגַּן־עֵדֶן לַעֲבֹד אֶת־הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר לֻקַּח מִשָּׁם
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh drove out the man and sent him forth from the garden of Eden to till the ground whence he had been taken.

items.body_raw: הָכְרַת מִנְחָה וָנֶסֶךְ אָבְלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְשָׁרְתֵי יהוה
items.answer_raw: The meal-offering and the drink-offering are cut off; the priests, the ministers of Yahweh, mourn.

items.body_raw: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יהוה לֵאמֹר עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים
items.answer_raw: And the Israelites cried to Yahweh, saying, We have forsaken our God and served the Baals.

items.body_raw: וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ וַאֲגַדְּלָה שְׁמֶךָ וַאֲבָרְכָה מְבָרְכֶיךָ וְנִבְרְכוּ בְךָ כֹּל מִשְׁפְּחֹת הָאֲדָמָה
items.answer_raw: And I will bless thee and make thy name great, and I will bless those that bless thee, and by thee shall all the families of the earth bless themselves.

items.body_raw: ברכי נפשי את־יהוה ואל־תשכחי כל־חסדיו
items.answer_raw: Bless Yahweh, O my soul, and forget not any of his kindnesses.

items.body_raw: And your fathers cried unto me and said, We shall perish from the violence of our enemies.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֵלַי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ נֹאבַד מֵחֲמַס אֹיְבֵינוּ

items.body_raw: And she said unto her husband, Drive out this maid-servant and her son.
items.answer_raw: וַתֹּאמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ גָּרֵשׁ אֶת־הַשִּׁפְחָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶת־בְּנָהּ

items.body_raw: And they forgot Yahweh, and he sold them into the hand of their enemies and they fought against them.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד אֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בָם

items.body_raw: And they took wives from all whom they chose.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּקְחוּ לָהֶם נָשִׁים מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר בָּחָרוּ
